name: Mika Ganbaru ~Oshiete Ecchi na Obenkyou~
original_name: 美香がんばる 〜おしえてえっちなお勉強〜
source: Mika is a young elementary school girl with a crush on her "onii-chan" a man in college who comes over daily to help her study. She wants to become the type of girl he'll fall in love with. She'll study hard and do her best to win over his heart!
translation: 米卡是一个年轻的小学女孩，迷恋着她的“哥哥”，一个每天过来帮助她学习的大学男人。她想成为他会爱上的那种女孩。她会努力学习，尽自己所能，赢得他的心！
